register.name: IVC/CIE (Interregional Packaging Commission)
register.notes: Members of an accredited scheme declare via Fost Plus (household) / Valipac (industrial); non-members declare directly to the Commission.

pro.ecoModulation: Fost Plus uses banded plastic tariffs (band 1 base ~€65/t, 2025, unverified).

notes: Indicative aluminium fee ~€48/t (netzerocompare, 2025) — unverified. Pull the current Fost Plus tariff PDF in the verification batch.
